question: Initially, Rekha works at such a rate that she can complete a piece of work in 24 h, but she works at that rate only for 8 h. After that, she works in such a way that she can complete the remaining work in 9 h. Rekha has to complete this work in one working period, then how many h will she take to complete that work?
solution:
Given:

Rekha works at a rate such that she can finish the work in 24 h

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of the worker × time taken by him

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of Rekha be x units/h

Now,

Total work = 24 × x

⇒ 24x

In 8 hours she will complete 8 × x = 8x units

Remaining work = 24x - 8x = 16x

If Rekha completes the remaining work in 9 hours then her efficiency = 24x/9

⇒ 8x/3

So,

The remaining work is completed = 16x/(8x/3)

⇒ 6 hours

Total time = 8 + 6

⇒ 14 hours

∴ She will take 14 hours to finish this work.
